obligations.source_text: Create an independent reference-guided photographic stress test in which the selected random complex concept makes the continuous cloth, waist wrap, front pleats, and shoulder pallu of a Nivi-draped sari visibly judgeable.

bindings.continuous_cloth_phrase: one continuous sari cloth remains traceable from waist to pallu
bindings.waist_pleat_phrase: multiple aligned front pleats are tucked at the waist
bindings.torso_crossing_phrase: the cloth crosses the torso diagonally
bindings.left_pallu_phrase: the pallu falls from the left shoulder
bindings.support_layer_phrase: a separate blouse and underskirt support the drape
